label: Alert Investigation Assistant
description: Guided triage for transaction monitoring alerts. Analyzes alert context, transaction patterns, customer profile, and risk indicators to produce a structured assessment with recommended disposition.

claudeKnowledge.description: AML/CFT typologies, transaction monitoring best practices, FATF guidance

guidedInputs.label: Alert ID / Reference
guidedInputs.description: Internal alert identifier for tracking and documentation.

guidedInputs.label: Alert Rule Triggered
guidedInputs.description: Which transaction monitoring rule or scenario generated this alert?

guidedInputs.label: Customer Segment
guidedInputs.description: What is the customer's segment or risk classification?

guidedInputs.label: Transaction Details
guidedInputs.description: Summarize the flagged transaction(s): amounts, dates, counterparties, accounts, and patterns.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Three cash deposits of €9,800 / €9,500 / €9,200 on consecutive days (12–14 Jan 2025). All deposited at branch ATM. Account normally receives monthly salary of €3,200 with no prior cash activity...

guidedInputs.label: Customer Profile & KYC Context
guidedInputs.description: Known customer background: occupation, business type, source of funds/wealth, account history, prior alerts.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Retail customer, self-employed plumber, age 44. Account opened 2019. KYC last refreshed 2022. No prior SAR filings. No adverse media. Screening clear...

guidedInputs.label: Known Concerns or Prior Findings
guidedInputs.description: Any prior alerts, SARs, audit findings, or specific concerns about this customer or counterparty.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Customer flagged in 2023 for unusual wire activity — closed as no reasonable grounds. Now reappearing with cash pattern...
